item.description: A certain kind of apocalypse horror hits harder than the sprawling wasteland stuff: the version where the world ends mid-class, the hallways become choke points, and the safest place you know turns into a trap. That’s the tension in the new trailer for “This Is Not a Test,” an apocalyptic horror-thriller starring Olivia Holt as Sloane Price, one of five teenagers trapped inside their high school while a zombie apocalypse erupts outside.
